generationAttempts.submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one readable full desktop DooKnow owner page, about 1440x1000. Image 1 is actual content/geometry; Image 2 supplies global header and flat compact styling. Preserve the real DooKnow book identity and full horizontal global header as in Image 2. A narrow left owner rail has account O, 笔记/最近/收藏/应用, bottom 回收站/设置. Keep the contextual sidebar and its search field, 新建 split button, contextual heading, add-folder and refresh icons, and resize divider. No invented navigation or header actions.
Sidebar state: query input contains 知识, then 搜索结果 heading, 混合检索 select, 所有目录 directory combobox. Search reacts automatically to query/mode/directory: do not draw a 搜索 submit button. Below show a folder result 30-Knowledge, filename result 知识整理.md, content result 入门指南.md with 第 3 行 and short snippet, 已显示 3 项, 加载更多搜索结果. Show plain feedback 语义检索暂不可用，已显示文本检索结果 and 检查搜索设置 link. No retry in this non-error state.
Main ready empty panel exactly: 选择一篇笔记; 从左侧目录打开笔记，或新建笔记开始记录。; 快速记录 blue action and 导入 Markdown secondary action. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. No browser chrome, ToDoo content, notifications or extra controls. Source caption is stored in metadata, not product UI.
